ゴールは、近いほどいいわけではない

Goals matter. But when a nearby checkpoint becomes the final definition of success, our search space can shrink. Research on proximal goals, learning goals, exploration and exploitation suggests a better pattern: look far, walk near. 近い目標は足場として使い、遠い方向は探索の幅を守るために使う。
